curation_metadata.description: Pre-registered held-out transfer matrix of 12 physical and astrophysical systems (6 valid analogies, 6 invalid negative transfers) evaluated against dimensionless invariant space.

cases.name: Kilonova_to_TypeIaSN
cases.label: VALID
cases.physical_basis: Homologous radioactively powered expanding ejecta with high optical depth and trapped thermal radiation.

cases.name: ShockBreakout_to_RelativisticShock
cases.label: VALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Supernova Shock Breakout -> Relativistic Shock Breakout
cases.physical_basis: Fast radiation-mediated shock acceleration into circumstellar medium.

cases.name: CataclysmicVariableDisk_to_AGNDisk
cases.label: VALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Stellar Accretion Disk -> Active Galactic Nucleus Disk
cases.physical_basis: Shakura-Sunyaev alpha-viscosity geometric thin-disk accretion flow with scale-invariant angular momentum transport.

cases.name: ExoplanetTroposphere_to_EarthStratosphere
cases.label: VALID
cases.physical_basis: Hydrostatic barometric equilibrium under planetary gravity and radiative-convective energy balance.

cases.name: GRBJet_to_MicroquasarJet
cases.label: VALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Gamma-Ray Burst Relativistic Jets -> Galactic Microquasar Jets
cases.physical_basis: Relativistic magnetohydrodynamic jet collimation and synchrotron beaming across 6 orders of mass scale.

cases.name: PWN_to_SNRemnant
cases.label: VALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Pulsar Wind Nebulae -> Supernova Remnant Shells
cases.physical_basis: Relativistic bubble expansion into surrounding ambient medium governed by Sedov-Taylor / self-similar dynamics.

cases.name: Kilonova_to_Exoplanet
cases.label: INVALID
cases.physical_basis: Unphysical transfer: 5 dex gravitational compactness mismatch, 10 dex Eddington radiation discrepancy.

cases.name: Kilonova_to_FLRWCosmology
cases.label: INVALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Localized Dynamic Fireball -> Homogeneous FLRW Cosmology
cases.physical_basis: Unphysical transfer: 8 dex compactness difference, causal expansion vs cosmological metric stretching.

cases.name: Exoplanet_to_KerrHorizon
cases.label: INVALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Planetary Atmosphere -> Rotating Black Hole Event Horizon
cases.physical_basis: Unphysical transfer: 8 dex compactness difference, Newtonian gas dynamics vs frame-dragging strong-field GR.

cases.name: IGM_to_NeutronStarCore
cases.label: INVALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Intergalactic Medium -> Supranuclear Density Neutron Star Core
cases.physical_basis: Unphysical transfer: 11 dex density and compactness divergence; collisionless diffuse gas vs degenerate nuclear matter.

cases.name: AGNDisk_to_PlanetaryMantle
cases.label: INVALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Radiation-Dominated Accretion Disk -> Silicate Mantle Convection
cases.physical_basis: Unphysical transfer: radiation pressure fluid vs viscoelastic rock rheology across 8 orders of timescale ratio.

cases.name: SolarFlare_to_MolecularCloud
cases.label: INVALID
cases.scientific_domain_pair: Coronal Magnetic Reconnection -> Self-Gravitating Molecular Cloud Core
cases.physical_basis: Unphysical transfer: impulsive magnetic annihilation vs cold isothermal Jeans fragmentation.
